blocks.x: Data & Lakehouse inside Education & Research: the operating realities we design for, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

In Education & Research, data, analytics & lakehouse is the substrate tower: pipeline modernization, lakehouse architecture on databricks and snowflake, streaming and event-driven decisioning, executive bi, master data and cataloging, predictive analytics, and data products that generate revenue. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: data engineering & pipeline modernization, lakehouse architecture & migration, real-time streaming & event-driven decisioning — delivered on Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: LMS, SIS, attendance and support-service data never meet; at-risk students surface at failure, not at drift.
Generative tools flood campuses with no policy infrastructure; detection arms races erode trust while legitimate assistive use goes ungoverned.
Advising, scheduling, accreditation evidence and grant reporting consume academic hours; support staff swim in document flows.

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: GDPR-K / minors' data rules and GDPR-K / minors' data rules. Heightened consent and profiling limits for K-12. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

Programs run on the fixed rhythm below, chosen so progress is legible from week one. The first quarter of the rhythm is verification: weeks 1–2 measure the current metric with your team and lock it by signature. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with your control owner receiving evidence weekly. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and the measured delta against the signed baseline. Gates are binding: miss one and the program stops or redirects with a documented decision.
